shortDescription: Membership registration and lookup landing screen.
fullDescription: Home view for membership operations with a branded top header, quick action cards for starting a new membership or reviewing pending processes, and a centered member search section with a search field and action button.

Reusable top navigation header for membership-related screens. It renders the brand mark, location selectors, country selector, and language selector with a secondary color bar beneath the main navigation area.

shortDescription: Action card for membership workflow entry points.
fullDescription: Reusable card used to present key membership actions with an icon, title, and optional highlighted background state. It supports entry points such as creating a membership or opening pending process flows.
